comment: it2 QA: reused verbatim from _it1_SUPERSEDED/qa/masks.json (CHK-LIKE4LIKE); declared BEFORE any it2 deviation number was computed; no mask added, removed or changed. Declared by QA BEFORE any deviation number was computed (2026-09-28, before the first deviation_gate.py run). Policy: only points that are not a surface deviation of the modelled part are masked. No scan-side (scan->CAD) mask is declared: unmodelled features (dimples, labels, barb rib, spline teeth, tip hole, plate hooks) ARE deviations of the part and stay in the gated number; artefacts are explained per cluster in review.json instead of masked. Gated CAD->scan is the observable split, which masks do not touch.

masks.name: M1 open boundary
masks.why: a CAD point whose nearest scan point lies within 0.8 mm of a scan hole edge measures the distance to the edge of a coverage gap (22 open loops: port-web orifices, bore interiors, column windows, cap slots), not a surface deviation
